title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-10-25
source: SBD MR > DAT > Sound Forge > CDR

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a stellar Dark Star with generally good sound despite a minor glitch in Let It Grow.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the Dark Star, calling it one of the top‑5 performances of the ’70s and praising its powerful opening jam and seamless flow. The recording is a soundboard source that preserves the entire Dark Star, though one listener noted an odd cut in Let It Grow. Overall the set is viewed as solid and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Four reviews show consistent high praise for Dark Star (average 4.25 stars). Minor recording glitch noted, but overall sound quality is good, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Full Dark Star retained; one reviewer mentions an unexpected cut in Let It Grow, otherwise clear and balanced sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 2 is anchored by a powerful, flowing Dark Star that carries the momentum; reviewers consider the show solid overall.
